name: DTU Puzzle (for phone)
description: A shared nine-piece jigsaw for a lecture hall. Open it on the big screen with ?screen, and up to four people scan the QR code and move pieces from their phones in real time. Grab a piece someone else is holding and it turns red, beeps and locks until one of you lets go; drop a piece near its place and it snaps in. Runs over Supabase Realtime; nothing is stored.
